review.decision_note: All eighteen selected sections compared whole against their rendered PDF pages; every one agreed, including section 136's clause run (a)-(zzl) spanning four pages.
review.scope_note: Each selected section was compared whole against its rendered PDF pages: heading, beginning and end, numbered parts, provisos and footnotes. Sections outside selected_keys were not looked at individually; they rest on automated whole-body agreement plus this sample.

admits_nothing_note: A passing review authorizes admission of this Act's aligned candidates through the canonical importer under review class text_agreement_sampled_visual. Provisions not in selected_keys are admitted on automated whole-body agreement plus this sample, and must never be presented as individually reviewed.
